items.summary: Canada's point man on the Canada-U.S. trade file says the federal government's strategy isn't changing in the short term despite American voters handing a seismic win to Democrats in Tuesday night's midterm elections.

items.title: In new memoir, Harper says he offered Carney a job — but not finance minister
items.summary: Former prime minister Stephen Harper says he offered Mark Carney, then the governor of the Bank of Canada, a role in his Conservative government in 2012 — though not as finance minister. Not right away, at least.

items.title: Philippine police find child sex abuse material on devices linked to Thomas Markle
items.summary: Philippine police said on Wednesday that three memory cards and a mobile phone turned over by the son of Meghan Markle’s estranged father contained child sexual abuse material.

items.title: At least one person killed, QEW fully closed in Niagara Falls crash involving tractor trailer
items.summary: At least one person has died and the Queen Elizabeth Way (QEW) is closed in both directions following a three-vehicle crash in Niagara Falls. Ontario Provincial Police (OPP) say the crash, which involved a tractor trailer, happened between Thorold Stone Road and Mountain Road Wednesday afternoon.

items.summary: Political watchers say the Democrats' landslide victory in the U.S. midterms, including in longtime Republican border states, is a “referendum on Trump.”

items.title: Conservative U.S. Supreme Court justices Thomas and Alito in spotlight after Democratic landslide
items.summary: The U.S. midterm election landslide that gives Democrats control of Congress starting in January is fuelling questions about the longevity of the Supreme Court’s two eldest justices, Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito, and the durability of its conservative majority.

items.title: Ontario tribunal finds Hollywood financier Jason Cloth defrauded film investors
items.summary: Ontario’s Capital Markets Tribunal has found that Hollywood financier Jason Cloth defrauded investors of money intended to bankroll film productions.

items.title: NASA space telescope plunges to Earth after two decades studying cosmic explosions
items.summary: One of NASA’s premier space telescopes plunged to Earth on Wednesday, ending its 22-year investigation of the universe’s biggest explosions.

items.title: Police arrest 23 people in connection with alleged cannabis trafficking operation that shipped drugs overseas in parcels
items.summary: York regional police have charged 23 people and are searching for another suspect after an investigation into an alleged cannabis trafficking operation that stretched across Ontario and parts of North America and Europe.

items.title: The 2028 U.S. election season begins as both parties navigate midterm fallout
items.summary: The final midterm votes are still being counted, but make no mistake: The next U.S. election season has already begun.

items.title: A dozen people arrested in Guelph Homecoming investigation, police still trying to identify more suspects
items.summary: Twelve people are facing charges for their alleged roles in a chaotic, unsanctioned street party during University of Guelph’s Homecoming weekend.
